    Profile

    An earnest warrior from the Sephira Village in the Gula Belt Region, she is known as the Vessel's Shield. She cares for the Vessel of Purification above all else, and lives solely to serve her and to be there for her at all times. Though highly intelligent, she tends to make simple, careless mistakes.

    Origin: Gula Belt Region
    Gender: Female
    Height: 174cm
    Weight: 54kg
    Birthday: Sep 26
    Blood Type: Type Kn
    Zodiac: Ice Water Wolf
    Likes: Training
    Hobbies: Cooking
    Illust: しぶ彦
    CV: 夏吉ゆうこ
